questions.prompt: Which declaration kinds, field sequences, and nesting relationships are explicitly defined?
questions.required_evidence: Cited grammar spans and authored entity or record IDs

questions.prompt: Which byte, newline, indentation, identifier, string, and position rules constrain parsing?
questions.required_evidence: Cited scanner spans and separately represented rules
questions.non_goal: Treating canonical formatting as silent input normalization

questions.prompt: Which recovery, diagnostic ordering, completeness, and truncation behaviors are required?
questions.required_evidence: Cited recovery spans and records preserving distinct behaviors
questions.non_goal: Claiming runtime behavior before it is observed

questions.prompt: Which supported grammar meanings cannot yet be represented or inspected through the bootstrap declaration subset?
questions.required_evidence: A cited meaning plus the exact missing declaration or projection capability
questions.non_goal: Classifying planned later-phase behavior as an implementation defect

questions.prompt: Which propositions are explicitly supported and by which source spans?
questions.required_evidence: Recognition IDs bound to exact source spans
questions.non_goal: Certifying a source statement as a world fact

questions.prompt: Which meanings remain open, ambiguous, or incomplete?
questions.required_evidence: Variables, candidates, observations, or explicit unknown reasons grounded in source

questions.prompt: Which constraints are explicitly grounded as relationships by the source?
questions.required_evidence: Constraint IDs with positive relationship support and grounding
questions.non_goal: Creating a constraint only because it makes the model viable

questions.prompt: Where could supported, allowed, excluded, conflicted, and unknown be confused?
questions.required_evidence: Separate support and viability observations with cited IDs
questions.non_goal: Persisting derived state as authored source meaning

questions.prompt: Which desired operations derive, choose, or conclude and therefore belong to llmthink?
questions.required_evidence: Cited source meaning and the exact proposed operation crossing the boundary

questions.prompt: Which desired operations create milestones, tasks, dependencies, resources, estimates, or execution state and therefore belong to perttool?
questions.required_evidence: Cited source meaning and the exact realization operation crossing the boundary
questions.non_goal: Adding planning or execution state to llmrecog
